## 3dslibris 2.7.5

Small fixes for EPUB image-heavy pages, bottom-of-screen spacing, and reader progress writes.

### Bug Fixes

* #77: paragraphs no longer create blank space at the top of the right screen.
* #77: EPUB text now uses the real last visible line before moving to the next screen.
* #77: EPUB image-only paragraphs and decorative separators no longer add invisible extra spacing.
* #77: EPUB publisher margins between paragraphs are preserved when there is room.
* #128: block images are less likely to be pushed or treated like full-page images.
* Returning from reader/settings no longer writes duplicate progress or preference updates.
